svg.title: Installing only the AI agent files (agent mode): Saying no to the full framework installs only the AI agent files
svg.text: Installing only the AI agent files (agent mode)
Scenario: Saying no to the full framework installs only the AI agent files

g.text: Given a fresh GitLab project with only a README on its main branch
GitLab's page for the main branch of a brand-new project. The Files panel on the left lists one file, README.md, and the
table shows it on the commit "Initial commit".
The project's random name shows as "project", and dates and avatars are hidden, so the picture is the same on every run.
When the developer starts the installer and picks "Choose components"
instead of the complete framework
The terminal, from the typed installer command down. The installer lists its two choices,
"Complete framework" and "Choose components", then asks "Install the complete DevSecOps
framework?".
The developer has moved to the answer "Choose components", the highlighted button, and is
about to press Enter.
Then a checklist opens with the AI agent line already ticked
The same terminal once that answer is given. The question is gone, and a checklist headed
"Select what to install" takes its place.
Its first line, "✓ Agent mode", is already ticked, and "Source publication" below it is not.
And once the developer confirms the ticked line, the installer installs
only the AI agent files
The developer presses Enter on the checklist as it is, and the checklist clears itself. The
installer then says "Agent mode installed." and "Installed the AI agent context: .agent/,
CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md.", and gives the prompt back.
When the developer commits the new files and pushes them to the main branch
Agent mode leaves the commit to the developer. The same terminal, cleared, then one typed line: it adds the new files,
commits them as "chore: install the AI agent guardrails" and pushes them to the main branch on GitLab.
Git answers "Your branch is up to date with 'origin/main'." and "nothing to commit, working tree clean": everything is
on GitLab now.

text.tspan: git add -A && git commit -q -m "chore: install the AI agent guardrails" && git push -q origin main && git status

g.text: Then GitLab shows the AI agent files beside the README on the main branch, and nothing else
The same GitLab page as the first card. The table now lists .agent, AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md on the commit "chore:
install the AI agent guardrails", and README.md is still on "Initial commit".
The Files panel opens .agent to show the rules and skills it holds.
